defs.def: moving or able to move quickly 快的；迅速的；敏捷的

ex.s: Fast forward to my first year of college.
ex.t: 快进到我大学一年级。

ex.s: Our fast train was packing with passengers.
ex.src: 2024全国甲卷·第四部分 写作
ex.t: 我们的快车上挤满了乘客。

ex.s: Jaramillo’s students live in neighborhoods where fresh food and green space are not easy to find and fast food restaurants outnumber grocery stores.
ex.t: 哈拉米略的学生居住的社区里，新鲜食物和绿地很难找到，快餐店的数量超过了杂货店。

ex.s: She owns a fast food restaurant.
ex.t: 她拥有一家快餐店。

ex.s: How fast a driver was going.
ex.t: 司机当时开得有多快。

ex.s: Catamarans are faster, but they’re not so elegant, and they’re not fun to pilot.
ex.t: 双体船更快，但不那么优雅，开起来也没那么有趣。

ex.s: Interestingly，the more cheerful the music was，the faster their heart rates were．
ex.t: 有趣的是音乐越欢快他们的心率越快。

ex.s: So two by two,I read library books as fast as I could go: rushing them home in the basket of my bicycle.
ex.t: 所以两本两本地，我尽可能快地读图书馆的书：把它们匆忙放在我的自行车篮子里带回家。

ex.s: Fingerprint scanning techniques develop fast.
ex.t: 指纹扫描技术发展迅速。

ex.s: You prefer healthy food to fast food.
ex.t: 比起健康食品，你更偏爱快餐。

ex.s: To stress the popularity of fast food with Americans.
ex.t: 强调快餐在美国人中的受欢迎程度。

ex.s: The production of jazz growing faster.
ex.t: 爵士乐的发展越来越快。

ex.s: He was talking fast        B.
ex.t: 他说话语速很快。

ex.s: The sky was clear when we ___47___, but storms move in fast in the mountains, and this one quickly ___48___ our peaceful morning trip.
ex.t: 当我们___47___时天空晴朗，但山里的暴风雨来得很快，这场风暴很快___48___了我们平静的早晨之旅。

defs.def: happening in a short time or without delay 迅速发生的；立即发生的

ex.s: I realize of how fast time flies.
ex.t: 我意识到时光飞逝之快。

defs.def: able to do sth quickly 动作迅速的；头脑灵活的
producing or allowing quick movement 可供快速运动的

ex.s: It’s an attitude best summed up as “Move fast and break things.”
ex.t: 这是一种最恰当概括为“快速行动，打破常规”的态度。

ex.s: Chesterton identified the core problem with moving fast and breaking things through a thought experiment.
ex.t: 切斯特顿通过一个思想实验指出了“快速行动、打破常规”这一做法的核心问题。

ex.s: These genes were much more active when the men had fasted before exercise than when they had breakfasted.
ex.t: 当这些男性在运动前禁食时，这些基因比他们吃过早餐时活跃得多。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

ex.s: a rapid rise of water surfaceB. the permafrost to melt faster
ex.t: 水面快速上升 B. 永冻层融化更快

defs.def: showing a time later than the true time 走得快

ex.s: Nothing kills the love for philosophy faster than people who think they understand Foucault, Baudrillard, or Confucius better than you — and then try to explain them.
ex.t: 没有什么比那些自以为比你更懂福柯、波德里亚或孔子——然后还试图向你解释的人——更能扼杀对哲学的热爱了。

ex.s: This variety, coupled with the fact that tiny forests grow up to ten times faster than standard forests, means they attract a rich abundance of wildlife.
ex.t: 这种多样性加上微型森林的生长速度比标准森林快多达十倍这一事实，意味着它们吸引了丰富的野生动物。

ex.s: It drinks water 30 times faster than man.
ex.t: 它喝水的速度比人快30倍。

ex.s: These systems are sometimes faster and more perceptive than we humans are.
ex.t: 这些系统有时比我们人类更快、更敏锐。

ex.t: 你不必跑得快或跑得____62____（看）很长时间就能获得益处。

ex.s: The world is changing faster than ever.
ex.t: 世界变化的速度比以往任何时候都快。

ex.s: A.The word is changing faster than ever.
ex.t: A．世界变化得比以往任何时候都快。

ex.t: 指挥杀手机器人军团 D．比数学家工作得更快。

ex.t: ____（充满）脂肪和盐；通过____（吃）更多的快餐，人们摄入的盐和脂肪将超过饮食所需。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关联的新型计时方式这些状况可能因全球变暖而发生变化．我们正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座钟它反映了几条主要阿拉斯加河流的总流量这些河流对当地和全球的环境变化都很敏感．我们已经编程让它在水流保持当前速率时与原子钟同步．如果将来河流平均流速加快钟会比标准时间走得快．如果河流变慢你会看到相反的效果．

defs.def: very sensitive to light, and therefore useful when taking photographs in poor light or of sth that is moving very quickly 感光快的

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 随着发令枪响，我会全力扎入冷水中，尽可能快地向泳池对岸游去，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。

ex.s: I was running so fast that I bounced off the trunk and  40   on my backside.
ex.t: 我跑得太快，以至于撞在树干上弹开，一屁股坐在地上。

ex.s: A.They developed very fast.
ex.t: A.它们发展得很快。

ex.s: According to an evolutionary psychology theory that a person's “life strategy” slows down or speeds up depending on his or her ___47___, exposure to a “harsh and unpredictable” environment leads to faster development, while a more resource-rich and secure environment has the ___48___ effect, the study said.
ex.t: 根据进化心理学理论，一个人的“生活策略”会因其____而放慢或加快——暴露在“严酷而不可预测”的环境中会导致更快的发育，而资源更丰富、更安全的环境则产生____的效果，该研究称。

ex.s: Even    66   (bad), the amount of fast food that people eat goes up.
ex.t: 即使____（糟糕），人们吃的快餐数量也在增加。

ex.s: So in physics class on Monday, l did the same, but the teacher spoke so fast that l couldn't take everything down.
ex.t: 所以周一的物理课上，我也照做了，但老师讲得太快了，我都没来得及全部记下来。

defs.def: firmly fixed and safe 船等
not likely to change or to come out when washed 不褪色的

ex.s: We need the ability to work out which messes are worth avoiding — because however impressively fast you move, some things can’t be easily unbroken.
ex.t: 我们需要具备分辨哪些混乱值得避免的能力——因为无论你行动得多快，有些东西一旦打破就很难复原。

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 能从窗户看到树枝的医院病人康复速度可能比看到建筑物或天空的病人更快。

ex.s: Psychologist Frank Farley has spent years studying people who jump out of planes and drive fast cars, as well as those who climb Qomolangma.
ex.t: 心理学家弗兰克·法利花了多年时间研究那些跳伞、飙车的人，以及那些攀登珠穆朗玛峰的人。

defs.def: in a short time; without delay 不久；立即

ex.s: The music industry is developing fast now.
ex.t: 音乐产业现在发展很快。

ex.s: Stop eating fast food and have breakfast every day.
ex.t: 别再吃快餐了，每天都要吃早餐。

ex.s: The rain was coming down so hard and so fast.
ex.t: 雨下得又大又急。

defs.def: firmly; completely 牢固地；完全地
